Moderator: 
Ladies and gentlemen, good day and welcome to DLF Limited’s Q2 FY27 Earnings Conference 
Call. We have with us today on the call Mr. Ashok Tyagi, Managing Director, DLF Limited; 
Mr. Aakash Ohri, Managing Director and Chief Business Officer; and Mr. Badal Bagri, Group 
CFO, DLF Limited. As a reminder, all participant lines will be in the listen-only mode, and there 
will be an opportunity for you to ask questions after the presentation concludes. Please note that 
this conference and meeting is being recorded. I now hand the conference over to Mr. Badal 
Bagri. Thank you, and over to you, sir. 
Badal Bagri: 
Good afternoon, everyone, and thank you for joining us today. We are pleased to report yet 
another strong performance reflecting the underlying quality of our assets, disciplined execution, 
our brand strength, and prudent capital allocation across a well-diversified mix of development 
and annuity business. Strong cash generation and robust balance sheet continues to position us 
well for sustained growth in future.  
I'll briefly talk about the operating and financial highlights. New sales booking for the quarter 
stood at INR 3,800 crores approximately. We launched Aureva, the luxury retirement housing 
address, which received an extremely strong response with a complete sellout. We continue to 
see absolutely strong demand for our super-luxurious project,  Dahlias, in the current quarter as 
well. 
Overall collections stood at INR 2,780 crores in the current quarter, resulting in operating cash 
flow of approximately INR 1,858 crores. Net cash position stood at approximately INR 15,100 
crores, despite a very, very strong dividend payout in the current quarter of close to INR 1,980 
crores.  
Our rental portfolio stood at 50 million square feet. The portfolio has now achieved its  
ever-highest occupancy levels: 96% in terms of area and 97% by value. This continues to be 
amongst the highest in the industry. The rental business maintained strong momentum, 
delivering healthy top-line growth and high-teen growth in profitability. 
Moving on to financial numbers, overall consolidated revenue stood at INR 2,298 crores. This 
includes a one-time gain of INR 738 crores, which is accounted for as other income, which is 
due to valuation of one of the investments which we have made in one of our JV companies, as 
per accounting standards. 
EBITDA stood at INR 1,060 crores, resulting in a net profit of over INR 1,300 crores. The gross 
margin potential of our development business continues to stand at approximately INR 40,000 
crores, with a potential of cash generation of over INR 42,500 crores. For DCCDL, our 
consolidated revenue stood at INR 2,014 crores. EBITDA at INR1,537 crores, resulting in a net 
profit of over INR 750 crores for the current quarter, reflecting a year-over-year growth of 17%. 
With this, I would like to hand over back to all of you for Q&A.
